title: Borja was a guide...
text:
Borja was an excellent guide with some very impressive objective knowledge.
The spiritual perspective gave the visit a lot of richness and depth! He also had a sense of humor.
author: Nada_H

title: Palaces ang gardens tour
text: Excellent tour includes multiple palaces gardens and scenic areas with a interesting maritime of the history and lore of the area. So much more informative and rewarding than trying to do this on your own with an audio guide
author: Willliam_B

title: Tour exceeded expectations
text: This was a great tour, taking in the full complex including the beautiful Generalife gardens and the stunning Nasrid Palaces. Ricardo was an engaging tour guide, moving us through the sights smoothly without feeling hurried. A good balance of history and local culture. The complex is spectacular and exceeded expectations.
author: Jane_B

title: An excellent trip into...
text: An excellent trip into the history of Andalusia, a guide who met our expectations, an experience that lets us discover the entanglement between Muslim and Christian civilization, frankly Bravo to Carina
author: MohamedAmineF_S
